traits.name: Tough as Nails
traits.text:
The alchemist cannot be critically
hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
The alchemist makes two attacks with
its pummeling strike or two with its iron shard
attack.

actions.name: Pummeling Strike
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit,
reach 5ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4)
bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed
on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked
prone.

actions.name: Iron Shard
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range
20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) piercing
damage.
